summary: Phase 1 is strategically essential — F-001 is prerequisite for 4 of 8 planned features. The workspace model types already define projectId/chapterId fields, tauri_plugin_fs is already loaded, and 937 tests provide a regression safety net. Main risks are data migration safety and store shape breaking, both manageable with careful execution.

decision_trail.decision: Hybrid storage: filesystem via Tauri FS plugin for TipTap JSON content, gateway SQLite for metadata
decision_trail.rationale: Matches brainstorm ADR-001. Fast file I/O via Tauri (no gateway overhead for content), rich queries via SQLite. Avoids BLOB bloat with version history.
evidence: brainstorm ADR-001 specifies filesystem + SQLite hybrid

decision_trail.decision: TipTap JSON as chapter file format (not plain text)
decision_trail.rationale: Fixes current bug where TipTap JSON formatting is lost on reload. Preserves formatting, styles, and structure.
evidence: NikoEditor maintains JSONContent in React state but discards on unload

decision_trail.rationale: Matches how writers organize work (book → part → chapter). Aligns with existing ProjectWorkspaceManuscript fields.

decision_trail.decision: Full content snapshots for version history (not operational transforms)
decision_trail.rationale: Simpler implementation, easier to debug, matches brainstorm F-002 spec. OT is overkill for single-user desktop app.
evidence: brainstorm F-002 spec specifies full snapshots
Myers diff on textContent for user-facing display

decision_trail.decision: Migration with localStorage backup and fallback
decision_trail.rationale: Data loss is the highest risk. Backup localStorage before migration, validate each file write, keep localStorage as fallback for one version.
evidence: Current drafts have no backup mechanism

decision_trail.rationale: DocumentEditor, NikoEditor, StoryBiblePanel all depend on currentConversationId. Adapter layer resolves chapter to underlying conversation/document for backward compat.

decision_trail.decision: Diff textContent for user-facing display, store full JSON for restoration
decision_trail.rationale: TipTap JSON is structured — diffing raw JSON strings produces noisy diffs. textContent diff is readable. Full JSON stored for accurate restoration.
evidence: Myers diff on structured JSON is noisy
brainstorm F-002 recommends text diff for display

decision_trail.decision: Progressive disclosure: sidebar and history rail collapsed by default
decision_trail.rationale: Matches success criteria. Existing users should not feel overwhelmed by new UI. Progressive disclosure reduces scope creep risk.
evidence: Current UI has no sidebar/history rail

supporting: ProjectWorkspaceContext already defines projectId, chapterId fields — extension points ready
normalizeProjectWorkspaceContext handles legacy field migration robustly
Zustand slice architecture is extensible — new ProjectSlice fits naturally
against: No SQLite integration exists — must be added to gateway
TipTap JSON not currently persisted (only text) — format change for all documents
No tree/sidebar component exists — significant new UI
33 files reference localStorage — migration surface is broad
Sidebar tree with drag-reorder is complex UI
gaps: niko-gateway code not found in repo — SQLite integration location unclear
Current useDraftCache stores plain text only — migration must reconstruct TipTap JSON
No existing component patterns for tree rendering in this codebase

risks.mitigation: Backup localStorage before migration, validate each file write, keep localStorage as fallback for one version
Adapter layer resolving chapter→conversation for backward compat

risks.area: Performance — file I/O on every save
risks.mitigation: Async saves with debouncing (existing 1500ms timer), worker thread for snapshot compression
Phased approach: read-only tree first, CRUD second
